title: Reader Chapter 17
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Applied scenario
examples.scenario: Title: Sarah Marks the Blank Page Before the Review Scenario: The stapled incident log glows under the medication-room fluorescents at 7:35 a.m. Sarah, eighteen months into management, has to review Mathieu, the nurse everyone has trusted for fourteen years. She sets the deadline log beside a blank sheet labeled feelings and identity. Before she drafts the first sentence, she writes, I am afraid he will think I am pretending to be a leader.
examples.whatToDo: Apply the move to the situation.
examples.whyItMatters: It transfers the idea to practice.
